This research resource supports diagnostic AI that explains its decisions through clinical features.

안과·유방·전립선 영상에서 무엇이 보이는지 정의하고(정성 지표), 어떻게: We define what is visible in ophthalmic, breast and prostate images (qualitative features), implement code to measure it (quantitative features), and link these features to disease evidence. The atlas provides a reference for collecting AI training data and developing features, supporting diagnostic AI that reasons in terms of clinical features.
